effect_text:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have a [Mirei Mikagura], delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon. If you don't have a [Mirei Mikagura], you may play 1 [Mirei Mikagura] from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_text: [All Turns] While this Digimon has the [Angel] or [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait, it gains ＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
